releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.2.3

- Description-only corrections now recognize legacy training events created and managed by earlier Bike Sync versions.
- Bike Sync still verifies the exact event ID, date, name, and managed identifier before changing only the description.
- Manual Intervals.icu events remain protected.
- Includes the complete workout text, animated exercise links, credential recognition, and request-ledger migration from 2.2.1 and 2.2.2.
